sloka: त्रयाणामेव भूतानां गतिरेषा प्लवङ्गम ।मनोनिलसुपर्णानां तव चात्र न संशयः ।। ७.३४.३९ ॥
transliteration: trayāṇāmeva bhūtānāṁ gatireṣā plavaṅgama ।manonilasuparṇānāṁ tava cātra na saṁśayaḥ ।। 7.34.39 ॥

translations.english: O monkey, this speed belongs to only three beings: the mind, the wind, and Suparna (Garuda), and there is no doubt that it also belongs to you.
